records.jp: ……こころ
records.en_original: Kokoro...
records.en_auxiliary: Kokoro...
records.en: Kokoro...

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん
records.en_original: Hey, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, Ao.
records.en: Hey, Ao-chan.

records.jp: ちょうどよかった。こっち来て？
records.en_original: Perfect timing. Sit with me a while?
records.en_auxiliary: Perfect timing. Sit with me a while?
records.en: Perfect timing. Sit with me a while?

records.jp: ……いろいろあったね
records.en_original: A lot has happened, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: A lot has happened, huh?
records.en: A lot has happened, huh?

records.jp: ……うん。私のせいで、ごめん……
records.en_original: Yeah. It's all my fault... I'm so sorry.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. It's all my fault... I'm so sorry.
records.en: Yeah. It's all my fault... I'm so sorry.

records.jp: ううん、愛央ちゃんのせいじゃないよ
records.en_original: Ao, it's not your fault.
records.en_auxiliary: Ao, it's not your fault.
records.en: Ao-chan, it's not your fault.

records.jp: わたし、何もできなかった
records.en_original: I couldn't do anything at all.
records.en_auxiliary: I couldn't do anything at all.
records.en: I couldn't do anything at all.

records.jp: わたしは……愛央ちゃんがリーダーになって、<CR>みんなを引っ張ってくれて、少し安心してた
records.en_original: I felt so relieved when you said that you would lead us.
records.en_auxiliary: I felt so relieved when you said that you would lead us.
records.en: I... felt a little relieved when you became the leader and started guiding everyone, Ao-chan.

records.jp: そのせいで、愛央ちゃんに頼りきりになっちゃってた
records.en_original: Because of that, I made you do everything. I was dependent on you.
records.en_auxiliary: Because of that, I made you do everything. I was dependent on you.
records.en: Because of that, I ended up relying on you completely, Ao-chan.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんだって、急にこの世界に呼ばれて……<CR>何もわからない中、頑張ってるのに
records.en_original: Even though you were just as lost as we were; thrown into a world you knew nothing about.
records.en_auxiliary: Even though you were just as lost as we were; thrown into a world you knew nothing about.
records.en: Even though you were suddenly brought into this world too, Ao-chan, and you've been doing your best without knowing anything...

records.jp: こころ……
records.en_original: Kokoro...
records.en_auxiliary: Kokoro...
records.en: Kokoro...

records.jp: 不安で、どっちに進めばいいのかも分からないときに、<CR>愛央ちゃんは「こっちに行こう」って言ってくれた
records.en_original: You helped me find my way when I was lost.
records.en_auxiliary: You helped me find my way when I was lost.
records.en: When I was anxious and didn't know which way to go, you said, 'Let's go this way,' Ao-chan.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんは、その方向が間違ってたかも……<CR>って思ってるんだよね？
records.en_original: Though, it sounds like you're starting to wonder if you didn't lead us in the wrong direction.
records.en_auxiliary: Though, it sounds like you're starting to wonder if you didn't lead us in the wrong direction.
records.en: You think the direction you chose may have been wrong, Ao-chan, don't you?

records.jp: ……うん
records.en_original: Yeah...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah...
records.en: Yeah...

records.jp: 違うよ。わたしたちにとっては、<CR>そうやって道を示してくれるだけでも助かっていて……
records.en_original: You don't have to. We just needed a direction, it didn't matter which.
records.en_auxiliary: You don't have to. We just needed a direction, it didn't matter which.
records.en: You don't have to. We just needed a direction, it didn't matter which.

records.jp: だから、愛央ちゃんはすごくて……<CR>ええっと、うーん……
records.en_original: So, what I'm trying to say is, that you're really... Uhm... Well...
records.en_auxiliary: So, what I'm trying to say is, that you're really... Uhm... Well...
records.en: That's why you're amazing, Ao-chan... Um, well...

records.jp: こころ？
records.en_original: Kokoro?
records.en_auxiliary: Kokoro?
records.en: Kokoro?

records.jp: ……ごめんね。うまく言葉が出てこなくて
records.en_original: Sorry. I can't figure out how to put this.
records.en_auxiliary: Sorry. I can't figure out how to put this.
records.en: Sorry. I can't figure out how to put this.

records.jp: ……ううん。<CR>そうやって言ってくれるだけでもすごく嬉しい
records.en_original: It's okay. Just talking with you like this makes me feel a lot better.
records.en_auxiliary: It's okay. Just talking with you like this makes me feel a lot better.
records.en: It's okay. Just talking with you like this makes me feel a lot better.

records.jp: ありがと、こころ……
records.en_original: Thank you, Kokoro.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you, Kokoro.
records.en: Thank you, Kokoro.

records.jp: 今度はわたしが手を差し伸べるって、<CR>決めてたんだけどな
records.en_original: I promised that I'd help those who were in need.
records.en_auxiliary: I promised that I'd help those who were in need.
records.en: I promised that I'd help those who were in need.

records.jp: 上手くいかないね……
records.en_original: Things don't ever go exactly as planned, do they?
records.en_auxiliary: Things don't ever go exactly as planned, do they?
records.en: Things don't ever go exactly as planned, do they?

records.jp: ……なかなか、思うようには行かないもんだね
records.en_original: ...They really don't.
records.en_auxiliary: ...They really don't.
records.en: ...They really don't.

records.jp: そうだね
records.en_original: Yeah.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah.
records.en: Yeah.

records.jp: ……そっか。みんな同じか
records.en_original: So it's like this for everyone, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: So it's like this for everyone, huh?
records.en: So it's like this for everyone, huh?

records.jp: こころも、私も、きっと他のみんなも、<CR>理想通りの自分にはなれなくて
records.en_original: Everyone wants to be their best self. They want to be perfect.
records.en_auxiliary: Everyone wants to be their best self. They want to be perfect.
records.en: Everyone wants to be their best self. They want to be perfect.

records.jp: でもだからこそ、周りを頼って、<CR>お互いの足りないところを埋めあっていくしかない……
records.en_original: So we end up depending on others to make up for our own shortcomings.
records.en_auxiliary: So we end up depending on others to make up for our own shortcomings.
records.en: So we end up depending on others to make up for our own shortcomings.

records.jp: ……うん
records.en_original: Yeah...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah...
records.en: Yeah...

records.jp: でも、一つだけ言わせてほしいんだけど――
records.en_original: But there is one thing I'd like to say.
records.en_auxiliary: But there is one thing I'd like to say.
records.en: But there is one thing I'd like to say.

records.jp: こころは、ちゃんと私に手を差し伸べてくれてるよ。<CR>今の言葉、しっかり私に響いたから
records.en_original: You said you haven't been any help to me, but that's not true. Even right now, talking with you like this is a huge help.
records.en_auxiliary: You said you haven't been any help to me, but that's not true. Even right now, talking with you like this is a huge help.
records.en: You said you haven't been any help to me, but that's not true. Even right now, talking with you like this is a huge help.

records.jp: ……うん。ありがとう、愛央ちゃん
records.en_original: Thanks, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: Thanks, Ao.
records.en: Thanks, Ao-chan.

records.jp: ……これが、お互いの足りないところを<CR>埋めあっていくっていうことなのかな
records.en_original: I guess this is one of the ways we can make up for each other's shortcomings.
records.en_auxiliary: I guess this is one of the ways we can make up for each other's shortcomings.
records.en: I guess this is one of the ways we can make up for each other's shortcomings.

records.jp: ……そうだね。きっとそうだ
records.en_original: Yeah. I think your exactly right.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. I think your exactly right.
records.en: Yeah. I think your exactly right.

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>選択する勇気<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>The Courage to Choose<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>The Courage to Choose<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>The Courage to Choose<CLNR> Fragment.
